_note: SHADOW-SUNCLAMP-1 verdict poses. mc2_10 is the ONLY tier map whose authored sun triggers mc2ClampShadowSunAltitude (LightDirPitch=180 -> lightDirection.z = sin(180deg) = 0 -> down = 0 < sin(15deg) = 0.2588). Map is 15360wu (+-7680), elev 0..750, water 80. These are WIDE full-frame poses at normal RTS gameplay altitude (alt 750-900, proj 28-34), deliberately spread across the map and rotated to span BOTH sides of the sun azimuth (LightDirYaw 28.75 + 45 = 73.75deg) so the reported shadowed-half / unshadowed-half split falls inside frame rather than being cropped out. Each pose is over populated terrain (props + relief), NOT empty ground -- the failure mode that got the previous fixtures deleted.
